description: Source file implementing entity-related functions for the game Unvanquished, including team checks, health management, and damage application.

classes.name: Entities
classes.description: Namespace-like class providing static methods for entity management and damage handling.

methods.name: OnSameTeam
methods.description: Checks if two entities are on the same team based on their TeamComponent.

methods.name: OnOpposingTeams
methods.description: Checks if two entities are on opposing teams.

methods.name: IsAlive
methods.description: Determines if an entity or gentity_t is alive based on its HealthComponent.

methods.name: IsDead
methods.description: Determines if an entity or gentity_t is dead.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Inflicts damage to kill an entity, optionally specifying a source and means of death.

methods.name: HasHealthComponent
methods.description: Checks if a gentity_t has a HealthComponent.

methods.name: HealthOf
methods.description: Returns the current health of an entity or gentity_t.

methods.name: HasFullHealth
methods.description: Checks if an entity or gentity_t has full health.

methods.name: HealthFraction
methods.description: Returns the fraction of health remaining for an entity or gentity_t.

methods.name: AntiHumanRadiusDamage
methods.description: Applies radius damage to human-class entities within range, considering visibility and notarget flags.

methods.name: KnockbackRadiusDamage
methods.description: Applies radius damage with knockback effect to entities within range.
